FUNCTION LinearSearch(Data : ARRAY OF INTEGER, Size : INTEGER, Target : INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER
    DECLARE i : INTEGER
    FOR i <- 1 TO Size
        IF Data[i] = Target THEN
            RETURN i
        ENDIF
    NEXT i
    RETURN 0
ENDFUNCTION

snippets.description: Binary search of a sorted array
snippets.body:
FUNCTION BinarySearch(Data : ARRAY OF INTEGER, Size : INTEGER, Target : INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER
    DECLARE Low, High, Mid : INTEGER
    Low <- 1
    High <- Size
    WHILE Low <= High DO
        Mid <- (Low + High) DIV 2
        IF Data[Mid] = Target THEN
            RETURN Mid
        ENDIF
        IF Data[Mid] < Target THEN
            Low <- Mid + 1
        ELSE
            High <- Mid - 1
        ENDIF
    ENDWHILE
    RETURN 0
ENDFUNCTION

PROCEDURE BubbleSort(BYREF Data : ARRAY OF INTEGER, BYVAL Size : INTEGER)
    DECLARE i, j, Temp : INTEGER
    FOR i <- 1 TO Size - 1
        FOR j <- 1 TO Size - i
            IF Data[j] > Data[j + 1] THEN
                Temp <- Data[j]
                Data[j] <- Data[j + 1]
                Data[j + 1] <- Temp
            ENDIF
        NEXT j
    NEXT i
ENDPROCEDURE

PROCEDURE InsertionSort(BYREF Data : ARRAY OF INTEGER, BYVAL Size : INTEGER)
    DECLARE i, j, Key : INTEGER
    FOR i <- 2 TO Size
        Key <- Data[i]
        j <- i - 1
        WHILE j >= 1 AND Data[j] > Key DO
            Data[j + 1] <- Data[j]
            j <- j - 1
        ENDWHILE
        Data[j + 1] <- Key
    NEXT i
ENDPROCEDURE

FUNCTION Factorial(N : INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER
    IF N <= 1 THEN
        RETURN 1
    ENDIF
    RETURN N * Factorial(N - 1)
ENDFUNCTION

FUNCTION Fibonacci(N : INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER
    IF N <= 1 THEN
        RETURN N
    ENDIF
    RETURN Fibonacci(N - 1) + Fibonacci(N - 2)
ENDFUNCTION

FUNCTION IsPrime(N : INTEGER) RETURNS BOOLEAN
    DECLARE i : INTEGER
    IF N < 2 THEN
        RETURN FALSE
    ENDIF
    FOR i <- 2 TO INT(N / 2)
        IF N MOD i = 0 THEN
            RETURN FALSE
        ENDIF
    NEXT i
    RETURN TRUE
ENDFUNCTION

FUNCTION ReverseString(Text : STRING) RETURNS STRING
    DECLARE Result : STRING
    DECLARE i : INTEGER
    Result <- ""
    FOR i <- LENGTH(Text) TO 1 STEP -1
        Result <- Result & MID(Text, i, 1)
    NEXT i
    RETURN Result
ENDFUNCTION

FUNCTION IsPalindrome(Text : STRING) RETURNS BOOLEAN
    DECLARE i : INTEGER
    FOR i <- 1 TO LENGTH(Text) DIV 2
        IF MID(Text, i, 1) <> MID(Text, LENGTH(Text) - i + 1, 1) THEN
            RETURN FALSE
        ENDIF
    NEXT i
    RETURN TRUE
ENDFUNCTION

FUNCTION GCD(A : INTEGER, B : INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER
    DECLARE Temp : INTEGER
    WHILE B <> 0 DO
        Temp <- B
        B <- A MOD B
        A <- Temp
    ENDWHILE
    RETURN A
ENDFUNCTION

CLASS Stack
    PRIVATE Items : ARRAY[1:100] OF INTEGER
    PRIVATE Top : INTEGER
    PUBLIC PROCEDURE NEW()
        Top <- 0
    ENDPROCEDURE
    PUBLIC PROCEDURE Push(Value : INTEGER)
        Top <- Top + 1
        Items[Top] <- Value
    ENDPROCEDURE
    PUBLIC FUNCTION Pop() RETURNS INTEGER
        DECLARE Value : INTEGER
        Value <- Items[Top]
        Top <- Top - 1
        RETURN Value
    ENDFUNCTION
    PUBLIC FUNCTION IsEmpty() RETURNS BOOLEAN
        RETURN Top = 0
    ENDFUNCTION
ENDCLASS
